values.meaning: Bonus Attack Speed gained upon breaking stealth
Duration of the bonus attack speed after breaking stealth
values.quote: Upon breaking stealth, '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 6 seconds.

values.meaning: Delay after cast before the camouflage (and its effects) begins
values.quote: After a 1-second delay, '''Twitch''' becomes {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} for a duration.

mechanics.claim: Attacking, or casting Venom Cask or Contaminate, ends Ambush's camouflage immediately (before its full duration elapses).
mechanics.quote: Attacking or casting ''{{ai|Venom Cask|Twitch}}'' or ''{{ai|Contaminate|Twitch}}'' ends ''Ambush'' immediately.

mechanics.claim: Entering stealth cancels Twitch's current basic attack (a swing already in progress is lost).
mechanics.quote: Entering stealth cancels '''Twitch's''' current basic attack.

mechanics.claim: A basic attack breaks Ambush's stealth (and starts the bonus attack speed) at the start of the attack's windup, not when it lands.
mechanics.quote: Using a basic attack {{tip|breaks stealth|breaks the stealth}} at the start of the attack windup.

mechanics.claim: Ambush's cooldown does not start while the ability is still active; it only begins once the camouflage ends (by being broken or expiring).
If an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Deadly Venom, Ambush's cooldown is reset immediately.
mechanics.quote: When an enemy {{tip|champion}} dies while afflicted with ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'', ''Ambush's'' cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reset}}.
